title_vi: Học thuyết UNKNOWN — Trường Chưa-biết Sinh thành của BL∞
title_en: UNKNOWN Doctrine — Generative Unknown Frontier of BL Infinity
central_thesis: BL Infinity is the open-ended generative principle; UNKNOWN is the dynamic contact frontier where a current observer/model/ontology encounters that openness. Intelligence evolves not by forcing UNKNOWN to zero but by converting unrepresented pressure into new distinctions, GiaTai candidates, representations, ontologies, capabilities and reachable actuality, which expose a deeper UNKNOWN frontier.

relational_model.open_dimension_rule: The ellipsis is architectural: no current coordinate list is allowed to self-certify as the final ontology.

imagination_relation.actualization_question: For a candidate C: identify required invariants, resources, technologies, transformation paths, actualizable portions and expected Reality-collision revisions.

unknown_unknown_diagnostics.response: Increase permission for representation mutation and discriminating tests rather than merely increasing search inside the old ontology.

closure_debt_heuristic.formula: ClosureDebt ~= Confidence * DownstreamDependence * Irreversibility * BlindSpotCorrelation / CorrectionCapacity
closure_debt_heuristic.meaning: Premature false-known closure becomes more expensive when many irreversible downstream branches depend on one correlated assumption.

unknown_weight_heuristic.formula: UnknownWeight(U) ~= CausalCentrality * DecisionSensitivity * IrreversibilityExposure * PropagationDepth * OntologyDependence
unknown_weight_heuristic.purpose: Prioritize UNKNOWN by downstream consequence rather than surface size.

projections_not_final_taxonomy.U_epistemic: observer/model does not know or cannot access
projections_not_final_taxonomy.U_generative: frontier where contact with BL Infinity produces new primitives, GiaTai or possibility structures

grand_ending_relation.fixed_infinity: infinite states inside fixed primitives and fixed rules
grand_ending_relation.b_infinity: the generative basis itself can evolve: primitives, relations, ontologies, agents, rules and construction paths
grand_ending_relation.counter_pressure: Life and intelligence can learn, create representations, cooperate, build tools and convert a subset of GiaTai into new reachable actuality.

core_propositions.text: UNKNOWN is not equivalent to falsehood or mere missing data.
UNKNOWN is a dynamic observer-model-history-access relation.
BL Infinity and UNKNOWN are distinct: UNKNOWN is a contact frontier with BL Infinity openness.
GiaTai is not falsehood; imagination operates as a generative representation mechanism on the UNKNOWN frontier.
Not actualized is not equivalent to impossible.
Knowledge growth can increase the visible UNKNOWN frontier.
core_propositions.formal: DeltaK>0 and DeltaU_visible>0 may hold simultaneously

core_propositions.text: Unknown-unknown first appears as strain on current representation rather than named content.
Representation failure can justify primitive or dimension genesis when new representations produce measurable gains.
False-known is premature closure of UNKNOWN and creates closure debt.
Future UNKNOWN may include not-yet-realized states.
UNKNOWN can have causal weight and lineage.
Collective intelligence depends partly on diversity of blind spots, not agent count alone.
Open-ended intelligence includes the ability to generate representations and survive ontology change.
A fixed infinite state space can remain generatively poor.
B Infinity concerns evolution of the generative basis itself rather than cardinality alone.
Life/intelligence may expand reachable actuality through UNKNOWN -> GiaTai -> construction -> Reality delta.

critique_policy: The document states the strongest internally coherent thesis and exposes propositions clearly. External critique should attack explicit premises, relations, gain tests or empirical interfaces rather than being pre-written as self-negation inside each section.
